components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Inverted-ink action button; the confident, colorless primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(12 7% 15%); color: #ffffff; font-family: 'SF Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.14px; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(12 7% 15% / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent toolbar workhorse; hovers to warm mist.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: hsl(12 7% 15% / 0.8); font-family: 'SF Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: hsl(60 5% 96%); color: hsl(12 7% 15%); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Tight 4px-radius field with hairline ring; focus flips the ring to Focus Salmon.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 8px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; background: #ffffff; color: hsl(12 7% 15%); font-family: 'SF Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #ecebe9; transition: box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #938c85; } .ds-input:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #daa48b; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

narrative.overview: Chorus is a native Mac tool that puts many AIs in one quiet room. The interface is a warm-neutral workspace — warm grays, hairline borders, generous whitespace — with a monospace, terminal-literate accent voice (Geist Mono micro-labels, ASCII flourishes, a retro loader). Design serves the product: chat content is the star, the chrome disappears into the task. Density is moderate; states are rich; motion is feedback, never decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Warm gray ramp on every surface; true white canvas in light, #1c1917 in dark
One accent family (Toasted Sand) for highlights and selection only
Monospace micro-labels as the signature voice element
Hairline borders carry structure; shadows nearly absent
Full light/dark parity via CSS variables

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: New UI never introduces hex/HSL literals. If a color isn't reachable through a semantic token, the design is wrong or the token belongs in src/ui/themes/index.ts first.

rules.name: The Quiet Accent Rule
rules.body: Toasted Sand marks state (selection, highlight, activity) — never headings, never fills for emphasis, never gradients.

rules.name: The One Kicker Rule
rules.body: The mono micro-label is Chorus's single deliberate kicker pattern. Reuse .sidebar-label exactly; do not invent second eyebrow styles.

rules.name: The Fixed Scale Rule
rules.body: Sizes come only from the four registered steps (10/12/14/16). No clamp(), no arbitrary text-[13px]. Weights only from 250/400/450/500.

rules.name: The Border-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: If a container needs separation, reach for border-border or a bg-sidebar/bg-muted tint first. A drop shadow on an in-flow element is a design smell.

dos: Do build every new surface from src/ui/components/ui/ primitives and semantic tokens
Do verify both light and dark themes before calling any screen done
Do keep transitions 150–250ms, ease-out, state-conveying; respect prefers-reduced-motion
Do use ResizablePanelGroup for new split layouts and the existing Radix kit for overlays
Do give every interactive component its full state set: hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, error, empty
Do keep destructive actions text-red-on-quiet, gated by ConfirmButton where irreversible
donts: Don't introduce hex/HSL/OKLCH literals, new fonts, new font sizes, or arbitrary Tailwind values in feature code
Don't use gradients, gradient text, glassmorphism, colored side-stripe borders, or hero-metric cards
Don't ship dark-mode-only or light-mode-only styling
Don't use solid red buttons; destructive stays quiet
Don't add drop shadows to in-flow content
Don't invent second kicker/eyebrow styles beyond .sidebar-label
Don't replace standard affordances with novelties (custom scrollbars, non-Radix modals, display fonts in labels)
Don't add orchestrated page-load choreography; Chorus loads into the task
